questions.def: Rasmiy uslubda qisqartma ishlatilmaydi: «shouldn't» emas, «should not» yoziladi.
questions.question: Formal reports ___ use contractions.

questions.def: Rasmiy uslub qisqartma va jargonni rad etadi; «we are pleased to» toʻliq, muloyim shakl.
questions.question: Regarding your request, ___ approve it.

questions.def: Ikkinchi tur shart gapda («If I were...») asosiy qismda «would + infinitiv» keladi.
questions.question: If I were in your position, I ___ you to consult a lawyer.

questions.def: «Please do not hesitate to» rasmiy xatlarda ishlatiladigan eng muloyim shakl.
questions.question: ___ contact me if you have further questions.

questions.def: Rasmiy uslubda «implement» feʼli ishlatiladi; Present Perfect natijani bildiradi.
questions.question: The company ___ a new policy.

questions.def: «Anyways» soʻzlashuv shakli; rasmiy uslubda «anyway» yoki «in any case» yoziladi.
questions.question: Anyways, I hope you have a great day.

questions.def: Artikldan keyin ot kerak; «explanation» toʻgʻri yozilgan ot shakli.
questions.question: The ___ of the phenomenon is complex.

questions.def: Rasmiy ilmiy uslubda «data» koʻplik hisoblanadi, oʻtgan zamonda «were» keladi.
questions.question: The data ___ carefully analysed last year by two independent researchers.

questions.def: «In my estimation» fikrni rasmiy bildirish shakli; «I reckon» soʻzlashuv uslubi.
questions.question: ___, I believe this is the best solution.

questions.def: «wanna» = «want to» ning soʻzlashuv shakli, rasmiy matnda ishlatilmaydi.
questions.question: I wanna thank you for your help.

questions.def: Rasmiy uslubda «inform somebody of something» qolipi ishlatiladi.
questions.question: Please ___ us of any changes.

questions.def: «Furthermore» rasmiy bogʻlovchi soʻz, fikrni qoʻshimcha qilib davom ettiradi.
questions.question: ___, I would like to express my gratitude.

questions.def: «address a topic» rasmiy qolip, predlog talab qilmaydi.
questions.question: The article ___ a controversial topic.

questions.def: «propose that» dan keyin subjunktiv — feʼl asos shaklda: he undertake.
questions.question: The committee proposes that he ___ the investigation.

questions.def: «with regard to» mavzuni rasmiy kiritadigan turgʻun ibora.
questions.question: ___ to the aforementioned issues...

questions.def: «Regrettably» afsus bildirishning eng rasmiy shakli, gap boshida vergul bilan keladi.
questions.question: ___, the results were inconclusive.

questions.def: «In conclusion» xulosani boshlaydigan rasmiy ibora; «In conclude» grammatik xato.
questions.question: ___, we find no evidence of wrongdoing.

questions.def: «Sincerely» rasmiy xat yakunidagi standart shakl; «Cheers», «Later» norasmiy.
questions.question: ___, thank you for your consideration.

questions.def: «elucidate» — «explain» ning rasmiy ilmiy sinonimi, toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri obyekt oladi.
questions.question: The report ___ the findings.

questions.def: «request something» rasmiy uslubda predlogsiz ishlatiladi.
questions.question: We ___ your prompt attention to this matter.

questions.def: «issue» rasmiy ot; «thing» va «stuff» soʻzlashuv uslubiga xos.
questions.question: The aforementioned ___ requires further investigation.

questions.def: «on account of» sababni bildiruvchi rasmiy ibora.
questions.question: ___ the delay, we apologize.

questions.def: «examine» — «look at» ning rasmiy varianti, sinchiklab tekshirishni bildiradi.
questions.question: The committee ___ the proposal thoroughly.

questions.def: «pursuant to» turgʻun rasmiy ibora, faqat «to» predlogi bilan keladi.
questions.question: Pursuant ___ your request...

questions.def: «Respectfully» ish xatini yakunlovchi rasmiy soʻz.
questions.question: ___, I remain at your service.

questions.def: «Should you require...» inversiya bilan tuzilgan rasmiy shart gap, «if» oʻrnida keladi.
questions.question: ___ you require further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us.

questions.def: «in due course» kelasi zamon; natijalar eʼlon qilinadi, shuning uchun majhul «will be announced».
questions.question: The results ___ in due course.

questions.def: «Anyways» norasmiy shakl; rasmiy yozuvda «anyway» yoki «in any case» ishlatiladi.
questions.question: Anyways, I was wondering if you're free.

questions.def: Inversiyali shart gap («Were we...») asosiy qismda «would + infinitiv» talab qiladi.
questions.question: Were we in your position, we ___ you to seek legal counsel.

questions.def: «Pursuant to» — «according to» ning rasmiy varianti; «Accordance to» xato.
questions.question: ___ to your request, we have approved the funding.
